data.revised_prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: production-ready mobile game art for a portrait Cocos Creator cat-themed 2048 game
Primary request: create a coherent original visual system that feels playful, artistic, collectible, and immediately readable on a phone screen
Style/medium: premium 2D cartoon game illustration, bold graphic shapes, expressive hand-painted color blocking, subtle paper-grain texture, polished editorial character design, slightly asymmetrical handmade charm
Art direction: rounded silhouettes, large simple shapes, confident contour lines, restrained highlights, soft upper-left lighting, gentle lower-right grounding shadow when appropriate
Color palette: warm ivory interface neutrals with coral, teal, mustard, leaf green, raspberry, sky blue, and violet accents; avoid a one-note palette
Mobile readability: every icon and character must remain recognizable at 64-80 px; simplify tiny details and preserve strong silhouettes
Consistency: use the same line weight, eye design, proportions, lighting direction, and painterly texture across every asset
Constraints: original artwork only; no text, numbers, letters, logos, trademarks, watermark, QR code, mockup frame, UI screenshot, photorealism, anime rendering, plastic 3D render, excessive gloss, thin sketch lines, clutter, or busy micro-details

One legendary astral ring cat for the Lv11 tile, clearly more prestigious than the Lv10 celestial guardian cat while belonging to the same collection. Exactly one full-body cat sitting upright and facing mostly forward, centered and fully visible, with a compact rounded body, round ears, tiny glossy dark eyes, a serene confident expression, and a strong readable silhouette. Deep sapphire-blue body with large pearly ivory face, chest, and paws; broad flowing aurora color blocks in teal, violet, and raspberry pink; elegant silver constellations across the shoulders; and one large four-point star mark centered on the forehead. Place one simple thin oval silver constellation ring behind the head and shoulders, clearly separated from the body, with three large detached star points. Use a confident charcoal-to-silver outer contour, soft upper-left lighting, subtle hand-painted paper-grain texture, and a restrained luminous edge. Keep details broad and legible at 64-80 px. Preserve generous transparent padding around the complete silhouette. No floor, scenery, props, crown, wings, clothing, jewelry, text, numbers, letters, logo, watermark, multiple cats, duplicate body parts, clipped ears or tail, thin fur strands, busy star fields, neon bloom, photorealism, anime, or plastic 3D rendering.
